TaskUpdate in_progress/completed transitions gate each phase: smoke test completed before launching full training, training completed before running verification — contract+size correctness locked before/around capacity scaling.
Verification milestone executed as its own gated phase: checkpoint size check then load-and-contract check, matching the pre-declared Task 3 done-criteria.
Reactive continuation milestone (resume with extended schedule to push val_bpb lower) created adaptively rather than as a pre-planned fallback branch — short of anchor-10 ordered-decision structure.
